newsitem.title: UK: Sears confirms approached on Freemans buy.
newsitem.headline: Sears confirms approached on Freemans buy.

text.p: Sears Plc confirmed it has received a number of approaches from firms interested in acquiring Freemans, the Sears home shopping business.

The company said the approaches were made after Britain's minister for corporate and consumer affairs decided to refer the proposed acquisition of Freemans by the Littlewoods Organisation to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
Sears said it is reviewing these approaches and will make a further statement when a final decision has been made.
Chief executive Liam Strong said it remained the board's intention to achieve the price expected for Freemans and to return the cash proceeds to ordinary shareholders.
"We are committed to achieving this in the shortest possible time frame," he added.
In a separate statement Littlewoods said it had withdrawn from talks with Sears. The deal would have given mail-order-to-football pools group Littlewood about 25 percent of the UK mail order market.
